2607.13234.title: Continuously Evolving Deepfake Detection: An Architecture and Public-Benchmark Evaluation of a Dynamic Detection System
2607.13234.paper_summary: Deepfake detectors that achieve near-perfect scores on academic benchmarks collapse on real-world content: recent in-the-wild evaluations report AUC drops of 45-50% for state-of-the-art open-source models. We argue this gap is structural: static detectors are trained once against a moving generative frontier. We present BitMind Forensics (BMF), trained through Bittensor SN34, an open adversarial competition that continually refreshes the training distribution. We evaluate one dated export comprising image, general-video, and human-video checkpoints across nineteen public datasets: the canonical face-swap suites (FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF v1/v2/++, DFDC, DFD, UADFV, DF40) and recent in-the-wild and AI-generated-media benchmarks (Sumsub, Deepfake-Eval-2024, WildRF, Community Forensics, AIGCDetectBench, GenImage, AI-GenBench, AIGIBench, RAID, GenVidBench, GenVideo-100K). BMF reaches 0.936 AUC on Sumsub's original images and 0.872 pooled AUC over its full four-condition manipulation battery (1.4M images), staying robust under perturbation (0.855 JPEG, 0.799 downscaled), while GPEN enhancement improves detection (0.996). On Deepfake-Eval-2024, it matches the best commercial detector on images (0.915 vs 0.90) and exceeds it on video (0.822 vs 0.79), far above the best open-source detectors (0.56 and 0.63). It reaches 0.991 AUC on a 21-generator AI-image panel and 0.918 on GenVidBench, and exceeds the FF++-trained frontier on DFDC (0.947 vs 0.843) and Celeb-DF v2 (0.9985 vs 0.956), both contamination-audited, with statistical parity on Celeb-DF++. In a temporal study, successive dated exports improve on held-out media from generators absent from the static baseline's training (image 0.842 to 0.902; video 0.864 to 0.936). Our evaluation harness is public, and at publication the production API serves the exact evaluated snapshot for independent verification.
2607.13234.paper_summary_zh: 深偽檢測器在學術基準上達到近乎完美的分數，但在現實世界的內容上卻崩潰：最近的野外評估報告顯示，最先進的開源模型的AUC下降了45-50%。我們認為這一差距是結構性的：靜態檢測器僅在不斷變化的生成邊界上進行一次訓練。我們提出了BitMind Forensics (BMF)，通過Bittensor SN34進行訓練，這是一個不斷更新訓練分佈的開放對抗競賽。我們評估了一個過時的出口，該出口包括來自十九個公共數據集的圖像、一般視頻和人類視頻檢查點：經典的面部交換套件（FaceForensics++、Celeb-DF v1/v2/++、DFDC、DFD、UADFV、DF40）以及最近的野外和AI生成媒體基準（Sumsub、Deepfake-Eval-2024、WildRF、Community Forensics、AIGCDetectBench、GenImage、AI-GenBench、AIGIBench、RAID、GenVidBench、GenVideo-100K）。BMF在Sumsub的原始圖像上達到0.936的AUC，在其完整的四條件操作電池（140萬圖像）上達到0.872的合併AUC，並在擾動下保持穩健（0.855 JPEG，0.799降級），同時GPEN增強改善了檢測（0.996）。在Deepfake-Eval-2024上，它在圖像上匹配最佳商業檢測器（0.915對0.90），並在視頻上超過它（0.822對0.79），遠高於最佳開源檢測器（0.56和0.63）。它在21個生成器的AI圖像面板上達到0.991的AUC，在GenVidBench上達到0.918，並在DFDC上超過FF++訓練的邊界（0.947對0.843）和Celeb-DF v2（0.9985對0.956），這兩者均經過污染審核，並在Celeb-DF++上達到統計平衡。在一項時間研究中，連續的過時出口在靜態基線訓練中缺失的生成器的媒體上有所改善（圖像從0.842提高到0.902；視頻從0.864提高到0.936）。我們的評估工具是公開的，並且在發表時，生產API提供了精確評估的快照以供獨立驗證。
2607.13234.author: Ken Jon Miyachi et.al.
